content.text: Getting your first pair of contact lenses is a big deal. But don't worry — with the right steps, you'll be a pro in no time.
content.imageDescription: A smiling teenage girl at a modern optometrist's office, holding a small contact lens case, bright natural light, portrait 9:16

content.text: The golden rule? Always wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water before touching your lenses or your eyes.
content.imageDescription: Close-up of teenage hands being washed under running water, soap lathering between fingers, clean white sink, warm bathroom light, portrait 9:16

content.text: Open the lens case and place the lens on your fingertip. Make sure it forms a perfect bowl shape — if it looks like a taco, flip it over.
content.imageDescription: Extreme close-up macro of a soft contact lens perfectly balanced on a fingertip, forming a clean bowl shape, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, portrait 9:16

content.text: Use one hand to gently hold your upper eyelid up and your lower lid down. This keeps you from blinking at the wrong moment.
content.imageDescription: Close-up of a teenager gently holding their eyelid open with clean fingers, preparing to insert a contact lens, mirror reflection in background, portrait 9:16

content.text: Look up slightly and place the lens gently on the white part of your eye. Then look forward and blink slowly.
content.imageDescription: Extreme close-up of a contact lens being carefully placed on the white of a teenager's eye, clean and clinical but warm, portrait 9:16

content.text: It might feel a little strange at first, but within a few minutes your eye adjusts and you'll barely feel it.
content.imageDescription: A teenager blinking slowly in front of a mirror, looking slightly surprised then relaxed and comfortable, natural bathroom light, portrait 9:16

content.text: Never sleep in your lenses unless your doctor says so — and always store them in fresh solution. With practice, it becomes completely natural.
content.imageDescription: A contact lens case sitting on a bedside table next to a bottle of solution, warm evening light, cosy bedroom setting, portrait 9:16
